A newly created **Fighter** starts with: **Longsword, Shield, Potion of Healing, and Torches** (item IDs 2, 15, 17, 23 — note item 23 is actually Torches despite a code comment calling it Rations, see bug B-09).

Defined in `worker/src/services/character.ts`, function `createCharacter` (starting gear logic at lines `:59` and `:65`), which also sets HP = d10 hit die + CON mod and AC = 16, per `docs/flows/character-creation.md`.
